notes.title: Patch 1.0.4a
notes.notes:
Some bugs have been fixed and an improvement has been added.

[list]
[*] Zafir's Healing touch skill have been fixed. Now, you can use it in battle or anywhere else;
[*] Now, if you have 4 party members on the Dark Grotto maps, you'll be able to return to the castle via teleport. It is located at Dark Grotto I -  the first map you enter, close to the entrance.
[/list]
Male Doll Team

notes.title: Burning Horns Game Preview Livestream
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.

We’ve been working hard to deliver [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1704310/Burning_Horns_A_Bara_Isekai_JRPG/]Burning Horns[/url], our first isekai game, and we would like to share a little bit of what we made for you on December 10th at 11H30 AM (PST).

This content isn’t available on the game demo posted on Itch.io, so it’s an opportunity to get a glimpse of what is coming in our next update.

If you haven’t wishlisted it yet, do it right now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1704310/Burning_Horns_A_Bara_Isekai_JRPG/

Also, don’t forget to follow our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/maledoll]Steam page[/url] because we are about to announce new games very, VERY SOON!
